351	/-! ### Flat base change of cohomology (Stacks tag 02KH, `i = 0` form)
352	
353	Let
354	```
355	   g'
356	X' ───→ X
357	│       │
358	f'      f
359	↓       ↓
360	S' ───→ S
361	   g
362	```
363	be a cartesian square of schemes with `g` flat and `f` quasi-compact
364	quasi-separated. Let `F` be a sheaf of `O_X`-modules. Then the canonical
365	base-change map `g* (f_* F) ⟶ f'_* ((g')* F)` is an isomorphism in
366	`S'.Modules`.
367	
368	(The full Stacks 02KH statement covers all higher direct images
369	`R^i f_* F` for `i ≥ 0`; the `i = 0` form encoded here is the
370	substantive content of `lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology(ii)` of
371	Stacks 02KH, with the `i ≥ 1` form post-iter-177 work after the
372	higher-direct-image bifunctor lands.)
373	
374	iter-177 (Lane QS-FLAT): the body constructs the canonical base-change
375	natural transformation via the mate equivalence of the
376	`pullback ⊣ pushforward` adjunction (Mathlib's `mateEquiv` of
377	`Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`), then exhibits the iso
378	via the `canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso` helper. The deep mathematical
379	content (Stacks tag 02KH / 02KE / 00H8) lives entirely in the helper;
380	it reduces affine-locally to: for a flat ring map `A → B` and an
381	`A`-algebra `R`, the canonical map `B ⊗_A H^i(X, F) → H^i(X_B, F_B)`
382	is an iso for any quasi-coherent `F` (the `i = 0` form is what we use).
383	The helper remains a typed `sorry` pending the affine-local reduction
384	+ algebraic flat base change; this is iter-178+ body work after
385	quasi-compact open-cover Mayer-Vietoris infrastructure is in scope. -/

387	/-- The canonical base-change natural transformation `g* (f_* -) ⟶ f'_* ((g')* -)`
388	associated to a cartesian square
389	```
390	     g'
391	X' ─────→ X
392	│         │
393	f'        f
394	↓         ↓
395	S' ─────→ S
396	     g
397	```
398	in `Scheme`. Constructed as the *mate* (Beck–Chevalley transform)
399	under the `pullback ⊣ pushforward` adjunctions on sheaves of modules
400	of the canonical 2-isomorphism
401	`pullback g ⋙ pullback f' ≅ pullback f ⋙ pullback g'` coming from
402	`g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g`.
403	
404	This natural transformation always exists (no flatness needed). The
405	content of the flat base-change theorem (Stacks tag 02KH) is the
406	*isomorphism* claim under the hypotheses
407	`[QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [Flat g]`; that claim is the
408	helper `canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso`. -/
409	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
410	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
411	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
412	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
413	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
414	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
415	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
416	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
417	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
418	      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
419	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
420	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)

462	`V`-section level: the unit produces a morphism of `𝒪_X`-modules
463	`N ⟶ (pushforward g).obj ((pullback g).obj N)`, and evaluating its
464	underlying `PresheafOfModules`-val at `V` gives a `Γ(X, V)`-linear map
465	`Γ(N, V) →ₗ[Γ(X, V)] Γ((pushforward g).obj ((pullback g).obj N), V)`.
466	By `pushforward_obj_obj` (definitional), the codomain is the same data as
467	`Γ((pullback g).obj N, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)` with `Γ(X, V)` acting through restriction
468	of scalars along `g.app V`.

474	`pullback_app_isoTensor_isBaseChange`, allowing the consumer iso to
475	discharge cleanly via `IsBaseChange.equiv.symm`. -/
476	private noncomputable def pullback_app_isoTensor_unitAtV
477	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (N : X.Modules) (V : X.Opens) :
478	    Γ(N, V) →ₗ[Γ(X, V)]
479	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N), V) :=
480	  (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app N).val.app (.op V)).hom

482	/-- **Step 2 of the Tilde-isoTop route** (iter-186 Lane F): the `Γ(X, V)`-linear
483	base map for the affine-open section formula.
484	
485	Combining the axiom-clean unit `pullback_app_isoTensor_unitAtV` with the
486	presheaf-restriction `((pullback g).obj N).presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op` (from
487	the larger open `g ⁻¹ᵁ V` to the smaller open `U`) gives a `Γ(X, V)`-linear
488	map
489	`Γ(N, V) →ₗ[Γ(X, V)] Γ((pullback g).obj N, U)`,
490	where the `Γ(X, V)`-action on the target is via the algebra map
491	`(g.appLE V U e).hom : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(Y, U)`.
492	
493	The codomain of `unitAtV`,
494	`Γ((pushforward g).obj ((pullback g).obj N), V)`, is definitionally equal
495	to `Γ((pullback g).obj N, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)` by `pushforward_obj_obj` (rfl), which is
496	what makes the composition with the presheaf restriction typecheck.
497	
498	`Γ(X, V)`-linearity uses the defining decomposition
499	`g.appLE V U e = g.app V ≫ Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op`
500	(definitional from `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE`): linearity in the
501	source over `Γ(X, V)` is inherited from `unitAtV` (via `g.app V`),
502	linearity in the target's restriction-of-scalars action is the
503	`Γ(Y, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)`-linearity of the presheaf-restriction map, and the two
504	chain definitionally to give `Γ(X, V)`-linearity.
505	
506	This is axiom-clean; the substantive bijectivity claim is encapsulated in
507	`pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_isBaseChange` (iter-186 Lane F helper #2). -/
508	private noncomputable def pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap
509	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (N : X.Modules)
510	    {U : Y.Opens} {V : X.Opens} (e : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
511	    letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) := (g.appLE V U e).hom.toAlgebra
512	    letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, U) :=
513	      Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V U e).hom
514	    Γ(N, V) →ₗ[Γ(X, V)] Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, U) := by
515	  letI algInst : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) := (g.appLE V U e).hom.toAlgebra
516	  letI modInst : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, U) :=
517	    Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V U e).hom
518	  -- The presheaf restriction map (Γ(Y, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)-linear; the source's
519	  -- underlying type matches the codomain of `unitAtV` definitionally).
520	  let restr := (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N).presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op).hom
521	  -- The Γ(X, V)-linear adjunction unit at the V section.
522	  let unit := pullback_app_isoTensor_unitAtV g N V
523	  refine
524	    { toFun := fun x => restr (unit x)
525	      map_add' := ?_
526	      map_smul' := ?_ }
527	  · intro x y
528	    change restr (unit (x + y)) = restr (unit x) + restr (unit y)
529	    rw [unit.map_add]
530	    exact restr.map_add _ _
531	  · intro r x
532	    change restr (unit (r • x)) = (g.appLE V U e).hom r • restr (unit x)
533	    -- `unit.map_smul` is over `Γ(X, V)`; the codomain action equals the
534	    -- `Γ(Y, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)`-action via `g.app V` (definitional from
535	    -- `Scheme.Modules.pushforward`). Then `restr` is `Γ(Y, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)`-linear
536	    -- (via `Scheme.Modules.map_smul` applied to the Y-side). The chain
537	    -- gives action through
538	    -- `Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op ∘ g.app V = g.appLE V U e` (definitional
539	    -- from `Scheme.Hom.appLE`).
540	    rw [unit.map_smul]
541	    exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N).map_smul (homOfLE e) _ _

580	            (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap (Spec.map φ) (tilde M) le_top

707	    -- `Γ(Y, U) → Γ((Spec Γ(Y, U)), ⊤)`, which is the structure-sheaf
708	    -- equivalence on the affine scheme.
709	    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) Γ((Spec Γ(Y, U)), ⊤) :=
710	      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom.toAlgebra
711	    letI : Module Γ(Y, U) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback hU.fromSpec).obj N, ⊤) :=
712	      Module.compHom _ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom
713	    Nonempty (Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback hU.fromSpec).obj N, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U)]
714	      Γ(N, U)) := by
